report_feedback.refresh_failed: Updates could not be refreshed. Displayed data may be out of date; your open draft is still here.
report_feedback.title: Report feedback
report_feedback.discard_description: These edits have not been saved. Other collaborators will not see them.
report_feedback.fields_help: Up to 20 typed fields per report. Only the uploader or workspace administrators can configure them.
report_feedback.schema_locked: Records already exist. Keep existing types and options; add optional fields or options instead.
report_feedback.record_help: Save applies to this record only. Concurrent edits are checked before saving.
report_feedback.conflict: Someone changed this record or its fields. Your input is still here. Copy any edits you need, cancel, then reopen the latest version and review before saving.
report_feedback.save_failed: Could not save. Check the field values and your permission, then retry. Your edits have been kept.
report_feedback.source_help: Use the original attachment ID from its preview or download link. Linking a file does not grant access to it.
report_feedback.archive_help: The record will leave the active list. Its values and change history are retained.
report_feedback.load_failed: Feedback is unavailable or your access has changed. Retry after checking your access.
report_feedback.collaboration_help: Saved edits are shared with authorized readers. While open, this panel checks for updates every 5 seconds. HTML itself cannot write feedback.
report_feedback.unsupported: This report contains a newer field type. Upgrade the client to edit; existing values remain readable.
report_feedback.not_configured: No feedback fields yet. Ask the uploader or a workspace administrator to configure them.

image.canvas_label: Image canvas. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, double-click to toggle actual size.
image.unavailable: That image is no longer available — skipped it.

attachment.preview_office_notice: PDF preview may differ from the original layout. Download returns the original file.
attachment.preview_office_sheets: Every sheet, including hidden sheets, is shown on one PDF page.
attachment.preview_office_not_configured: Office preview is not enabled on this server. Ask an administrator to configure the conversion service.
attachment.preview_office_too_large: Office preview supports files up to 20 MB and a converted PDF up to 40 MB. Download the original to view it.
attachment.preview_office_invalid: This document could not be converted. Check that it is valid and not password-protected.
attachment.preview_office_busy: The preview service is busy. Try again in a moment.
attachment.preview_office_timeout: Preview conversion timed out. Retry or download the original.
attachment.download_failed: Couldn't fetch a download link. Try again in a moment.
attachment.preview_too_large: File is too large to preview. Please download.
attachment.preview_unsupported: This file type can't be previewed.
attachment.structured_parse_failed: Couldn't parse this file, so it's shown as text.
